reviewer.identifier: Codex; Stage 1 whole-Model semantic review against fetched baseline fa5c14ea731539b24ac9c8f5741e2fdddcbdc81a. Read all 16 statements and four arguments, their summaries, explanations, qualifiers, dependencies, evidence boundaries, governing policy, helpers, schemas, and presentation. Inspected the diff and exact normalized content equivalence. Authorized ID/path/field/terminology migration only; no proposition, inference, confidence, benefit criterion, or reading order changed. Rechecked the final identifier helper and statement template after the author requested bare S-### comment keys: data.id is passed directly, with no prefix or legacy aliases. This presentation change leaves all reviewed propositions and relationships intact; no external comment data changed.

src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.proposition: S-005, S-006, S-009, and S-011 motivate S-014 through practical synthesis under uncertainty.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.qualifiers: Some and can keep their exact empirical scope; what if any preserves withholding. Opportunities and effective inputs need not overlap in person, state, task, input, or timescale.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.evidenceSeparation: Detection, matching, selection, and benefit-risk judgment remain missing person-level conditions, not established empirical premises. Effect and uncertainty are kept separate.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.alignment: Premise order, conclusion, scheme, summary, and exact S-009/S-011 quotations are preserved. The target versus safety/comfort distinction is unchanged.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.inferenceAndImpact: The normative decision principle and proposed adjustment target remain explicit defeasible bridges. Philosophical rationale does not establish efficacy or the presence of an actionable match; the migration adds no bridge.

src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.proposition: S-004 and S-005 motivate S-006 through normative scope reasoning about an independently legitimate functional aim.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.qualifiers: Open-ended potential and a legitimate aim do not force every interpretation or identify a present opportunity; non-necessity of symptoms concerns rationale.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.evidenceSeparation: No empirical efficacy premise is introduced. Benefits for an asymptomatic person still require an opportunity, an effective input in that state, and net-positive outcomes.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.alignment: Ordered premises, conclusion, scheme, summary, and independent-aim bridge are unchanged. The route still concerns permission to consider care rather than sufficient grounds for action.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.inferenceAndImpact: The exact brief premises do not entail all scope interpretations, so defeasible remains appropriate. S-014 and ARG-002 independently address the functional target and person-level actionability.

src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.proposition: S-001 and S-002 jointly motivate S-003 through methodological synthesis.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.qualifiers: The conclusion is a revisable choice, not the only possible method or a necessary consequence of the brief premises.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.evidenceSeparation: The adopted defeasible route does not establish empirical premise truth or subject-matter efficacy.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.alignment: Ordered premises, conclusion, summary, and explanation match the baseline after ID and statement-type terminology substitution. Argument ID, scheme, and route are unchanged.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.inferenceAndImpact: Both premise meanings remain intact. No dependency arrow is used as proof and the inference remains defeasible rather than being promoted to deduction.

src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.proposition: S-014 and S-015 motivate S-016 through the practical principle of examining a hypothesis-directed input before deciding what follows.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.qualifiers: An input triggers the sequence; target and relevant conditions must be comparable. No-input cases do not trigger post-application reassessment and further input stays conditional.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.evidenceSeparation: Informative observations, reliable measures, and valid thresholds remain unestablished. Observed change supplies no automatic causal, mechanistic, durable, or broader-benefit conclusion.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.alignment: Ordered premises, conclusion, scheme, summary, practical principle, and alternatives remain identical apart from statement references.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.inferenceAndImpact: The route remains defeasible because learning and subsequent decision-making require additional methodological choices and capabilities. It does not turn repeated testing into an obligation to repeat intervention.

src/content/model/statements/assessment..proposition: Practical strategy developing a working hypothesis about a present actionable opportunity and what available input, if any, has sufficient expected value.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..qualifiers: Presently, can be identified, and what if any delimit judgment and preserve withholding. Failure to identify a target does not prove its absence.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..evidenceSeparation: Adoption of the strategy leaves detection, prediction, selection, decision thresholds, and safety procedures unvalidated. Empirical premises retain their asserted scope despite unresolved confidence.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, target definition, missed-opportunity discussion, safety/comfort distinction, and boundary remain aligned.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..inferenceAndImpact: S-005 normative, S-006 conceptual, and S-009/S-011 practical dependencies retain their limiting notes. ARG-002 exposes non-overlap and missing person-level conditions; S-015 and S-016 retain conditional action and reassessment.

src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.proposition: Empirical assertion of broader net-positive gains from some chiropractic-produced neuromotor changes.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.qualifiers: Some limits occurrence without implying a frequency or universal promise. Broader and net-positive require more than an immediate changed measure.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved; existing evidence does not establish transfer. Causal attribution, meaningful duration, valid outcomes, and harms remain empirical burdens.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.alignment: The exact assertion, summary, transfer explanation, evidence note, and revision conditions remain unchanged. Benefit is still assessed with the S-005 criterion.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 conceptual and S-011 empirical dependencies preserve revision impact without establishing transfer. S-013 is related only, stored on S-013; no argument or causal edge joins the two hypotheses.

src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.proposition: Framework scope statement that symptoms, injury, disease, or pathology are unnecessary to supply a rationale for considering chiropractic care.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.qualifiers: Non-necessity concerns rationale, not universal benefit or a warranted adjustment now. Safety and comfort can still require withholding or modifying an input.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.evidenceSeparation: An independent functional rationale supplies no effectiveness evidence for asymptomatic people. Adoption does not establish detection or selection validity.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.alignment: The exact statement and summary retain the distinction between rationale, functional adjustment target, and safety. The S-014 cross-reference remains application context.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.inferenceAndImpact: S-004 conceptual and S-005 normative dependencies are unchanged. ARG-004 stays defeasible; S-014 and ARG-002 separately expose person-level actionability and do not derive it from philosophical scope.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: Conditional practical application of a selected input as an intentional training stimulus to test and act on the assessment hypothesis.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: When proceeding is warranted governs action; intended describes purpose rather than an asserted successful effect. No warranted input means this step is not taken.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved. Delivery proves neither perturbation, reorganization, learning, benefit, nor appropriate repeated dosing.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, intentional-use explanation, withholding condition, and delivery-protocol deferral preserve the same practical commitment.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: S-011 and S-014 remain distinct practical dependencies for the proposed mechanism/response and selection hypothesis. ARG-003 and S-016 still require informative reassessment rather than presuming causal success.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: Empirical assertion that some chiropractic inputs produce beneficial neuromotor changes through perturbation; intentional training is described separately.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: Some limits scope and does not promise an effect from every input. Prospective selection prevents favorable outcomes from defining appropriate inputs after the fact.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: The effect assertion is preserved with unresolved confidence. Documented evidence still establishes neither chiropractic instantiation, net benefit, nor selection validity.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: Statement, summary, evidence, boundary, and revision conditions test actual effects and mechanism rather than intention alone. The beneficial-effect hypothesis has not been weakened.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 conceptual and S-010 empirical dependencies are unchanged. Downstream S-012, S-013, S-014, S-015 and ARG-002 retain their independent transfer, mediation, selection, and action conditions; no missing bridge is supplied by renaming.

src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.proposition: Framework rule separating statement classification, logical validity, premise truth, and evidential strength.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.qualifiers: The deductive condition delimits validity and soundness; current acceptance is explicitly insufficient to establish truth.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved empirical confidence remains compatible with adoption. There is no editorial status or Boolean soundness field.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.alignment: The statement and summary are unchanged; the body now calls the canonical record a statement and its metadata statement type, with no change to the intellectual categories.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.inferenceAndImpact: S-001 remains a methodological dependency. S-003 and ARG-001 use the evaluation distinctions without treating that dependency as inferential support.

src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.proposition: Framework rule requiring inspectable premises, scope, modality, and inference before independent empirical evaluation.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.qualifiers: Where a conclusion is proposed scopes the rule. Deductive necessity is distinguished from defeasible reasoning; the analytical order is not a one-way history of inquiry.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.evidenceSeparation: Empirical support can revise premises and conclusions but cannot establish validity. Uncertainty alone licenses neither hedging an assertion nor strengthening it.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, modal examples, and failure discussion retain the proposition/confidence distinction. Renaming records to statements does not change the method.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.inferenceAndImpact: S-001 and S-002 retain methodological dependencies and are ARG-001 premises. ARG-001 remains a defeasible methodological synthesis; no claim of unique or deductively forced methodology is added.

src/content/model/statements/functional-.proposition: Framework starting commitment that human functional potential is open-ended across changing circumstances.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.qualifiers: Open-ended excludes a health-status endpoint without asserting limitless capacity, inevitable improvement, or a present opportunity for everyone.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains not-applicable for the framework commitment. Particular capacities and chiropractic effects still require independent evidence.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.alignment: The statement, summary, boundary, and coherence-based revision condition preserve the same scope and impose no obligation to optimize or continue care.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.inferenceAndImpact: Root statement. S-005 and S-006 retain conceptual dependencies; ARG-004 still requires an independent normative principle and supplies no person-level efficacy premise.

src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.proposition: Empirical assertion of a central neural role in organizing, coordinating, and regulating human function.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.qualifiers: Central denotes integration within interacting systems, not sole control or a universal ranking of systems.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence reflects the missing appraisal of the broad formulation, without making every component equally uncertain or treating the proposition as false.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, whole-person explanation, and scope-specific revision condition are aligned. No revised organismic account is introduced.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.inferenceAndImpact: Root statement independent of S-004. Its empirical dependency to S-013 retains revision impact only; neural integration does not establish chiropractic mediation or primacy.

src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.proposition: Empirical assertion that chiropractic influences broader function principally through nervous-system-mediated change.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.qualifiers: Principally proposes the main route, not exclusive mediation or guaranteed effects in every person. Broader effects need not have established net-positive value.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.evidenceSeparation: Mediation, primacy, and particular pathways retain distinct unresolved empirical burdens; neither general integration nor an immediate neuromotor response confirms them.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.alignment: The assertion, summary, three empirical questions, evidence note, boundaries, and separate revision conditions match the baseline commitment.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.inferenceAndImpact: S-007 and S-011 remain empirical revision dependencies. The single related pair with S-012 remains see-also only; neither neural primacy nor broader benefit is inferred from the other.

src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.proposition: Empirical capacity claim: some context-limiting motor strategies can be modified for overall functional improvement; the body separately defines a candidate neuromotor constraint.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.qualifiers: Some limits cases, can asserts modifiability, and given context limits interpretation. The working definition supplies neither existence nor reliable detection.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.evidenceSeparation: The existing force-field practice example remains limited to task-specific motor adaptation. Unresolved confidence does not convert the capacity assertion into mere intention.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, constraint/opportunity distinction, subluxation reinterpretation, evidence note, and revision conditions preserve the same commitment.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 and S-008 retain conceptual roles; S-014 retains its practical dependency. ARG-002 explicitly withholds a person-level match between S-009 opportunities and S-011 effective inputs.

src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.proposition: Framework commitment assigning connected roles to philosophy, science, and art; no biological or efficacy conclusion is asserted.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.qualifiers: Contextual application and iterative reconsideration remain conditions of the method; best-supported does not claim that all current practice has strong support.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.evidenceSeparation: Historical Stephenson and Strauss references remain provenance, not empirical authority. Working adoption is separate from evidence and validity.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.alignment: The unchanged proposition, summary, explanatory triad, and historical attribution agree. Only the permanent ID changes from M-001 to S-001.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.inferenceAndImpact: Root statement; its methodological dependencies to S-002 and S-003 and its premise role in ARG-001 retain exactly their prior meanings. Display order supplies no inference.

src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.proposition: Value statement adopting net-positive functional improvement as a legitimate chiropractic aim in its own right.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.qualifiers: A legitimate aim is not an exclusive aim. Net-positive retains goals, context, harms, burdens, tradeoffs, and timescale; a changed test is not automatically improvement.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.evidenceSeparation: Normative legitimacy neither establishes a chiropractic effect nor proves a particular input warranted. Confidence remains not-applicable.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.alignment: The benefit criterion and symptom boundary are unchanged. Better function remains itself a valued benefit, without requiring an additional identified downstream outcome.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.inferenceAndImpact: S-004 retains its conceptual role. Dependencies to S-006, S-009, S-011, S-012, and S-014 preserve their individual roles and limits. ARG-002 and ARG-004 retain their normative bridges without creating efficacy evidence.

src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.proposition: Practical strategy repeating assessment after an input to test the working hypothesis and decide whether to stop, revise, or consider another input.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.qualifiers: Following input scopes the trigger; when justified preserves conditional follow-up. An unchanged finding does not make further input obligatory.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.evidenceSeparation: Observed differences remain compatible with variability, expectation, repeated testing, and measurement error. Confidence remains unresolved and reassessment validity unestablished.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, explanatory stopping options, and boundary distinguish testing a hypothesis from proving causation, mechanism, durability, or broader benefit.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.inferenceAndImpact: S-014 and S-015 retain practical dependencies and remain ARG-003 premises. Next-cycle feedback to S-014 stays narrative, with no new same-cycle dependency or reading-path edge.

src/content/model/statements/salient-per.proposition: General empirical mechanism hypothesis that a sufficiently salient neurobiomechanical perturbation can prompt strategy reevaluation and reorganization.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.qualifiers: Can is capacity; sufficiently salient is a condition requiring prospective definition. Reorganization can be neutral, transient, or harmful.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved and no claim-specific appraisal is added. Neither intended use nor general mechanism supplies chiropractic efficacy evidence.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.alignment: The exact statement, capacity summary, salience boundary, and falsifiable revision conditions remain aligned; unsuccessful inputs cannot automatically be excluded as insufficiently salient.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.inferenceAndImpact: S-008 retains a conceptual domain dependency. S-011 retains an empirical mechanism dependency, which establishes neither chiropractic instantiation nor benefit.

src/content/model/statements/state-depen.proposition: Empirical statement that neuromotor function depends on state, task, and environment, with limited or poorly suited strategies in some circumstances.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.qualifiers: In some circumstances limits scope. Variation, stiffness, or difference from average does not itself establish a constraint worth changing.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.evidenceSeparation: The existing standing-threat and pointing examples retain their narrow support. Confidence stays unresolved; no new literature appraisal or chiropractic confirmation is asserted.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.alignment: The proposition, summary, task examples, measurement alternatives, and revision condition are unchanged apart from references to renamed statements.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.inferenceAndImpact: Root statement independent of S-007. Conceptual dependencies to S-009 and S-010 define the motor domain without establishing beneficial modifiability or the perturbation mechanism.
